title: SO-2.04 Cross-project intelligence: evidence-backed discovery across otherwise independent work
request: Closes G-SO-15. Source: the master traceability baseline of 31 October 2026 (section 8.3) and, where named, the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0); 8.3 to 8.6 released for contracting by the owner on 31 Oct 2026. This contract is the design-record stage: it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. The programme decomposition on branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile (docs/scope-one/programme/) is read for overlap: WP08-04 builds a prototype of cross-project conflict detection; this contract is the design record it should consume, and builds nothing.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Evidence-backed discovery of recurring risks, dependencies, conflicts, assumptions and reusable knowledge
Every material finding should link to the source records, relevant scope and time context, affected entities and reasoning basis.
Distinguish observed facts, recorded decisions, agent-generated inferences, assumptions and recommendations.
State uncertainty, conflicting sources and missing context. Do not manufacture consensus from repetition or from multiple agents that share the same underlying source.
Support dismissal, correction, adjudication and feedback so that false positives do not become permanent organisational memory.
